scope: Frozen v29 canonical HTML/HTM/XML/CSS missing-image markers excluding news and native JS gallery targets; no raw image payloads were read or hashed.

frozen_exclusions.selection_rule: Exact normalized identity exclusion; plan/queue evidence is not execution evidence.

state_definitions.complete_cdx_no_eligible_capture: Explicit complete CDX window with no eligible image capture and no 404 row.
state_definitions.prior_execution_complete_404_or_no_image: Execution/CDX evidence contains a complete 404 or no-image result; not re-queued in this frontier.
state_definitions.prior_execution_transport_unknown: Execution evidence records transport or HTTP status unknown; requires a new bounded window.
state_definitions.plan_or_queue_only_no_execution_record: Only plan/queue evidence exists; this is not an executed request.
state_definitions.no_matching_execution_or_cdx_record_foun: No matching local execution/CDX evidence found.

native_dynamic_gallery.scope: Extension of immutable v7 native-directory coverage; exact native payload probe counters remain 79 archive404,47 transportunknown,3242 not requested. Nested guide previews are separate from native ssN entities.
native_dynamic_gallery.followup: Only two transport-unknown windows may be retried under a new bounded plan; do not repeat completed ZulAman window.

selection_policy.priority: Photos, screenshots, illustrations, maps, knowledge visuals, and event visuals first; item/resource images next; Armory icon rows only as a final remainder up to eight.
selection_policy.layout_filter: Pure border, pixel, spacer, UI separator, captcha, and known tab/corner assets are excluded.
selection_policy.evidence_rule: complete CDX empty/404 and already accepted rows are not re-queued; transport_unknown, plan-only, outside-receipt, and uncovered remain distinct.
selection_policy.native_gallery_rule: 3368/native JS50 gallery targets stay in a separate ledger and are not counted as static candidates.
